title: trifolium strepens
intro: Trifolium strepens, commonly known as red clover, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to promote women's health, particularly in alleviating menopausal symptoms and supporting breast health. The health benefits of red clover include its potential to reduce hot flashes, night sweats, and mood swings associated with menopause, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of red clover include isoflavones, particularly genistein and daidzein, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as estrogenic activity and anti-proliferative effects.
